title: CGPE Connect — Server-Driven Mobile UI Configuration

_README.purpose: Contract between the web Admin Panel and the CGPE Connect mobile app. The Admin Panel writes one document per role into the `app_role_preferences` MongoDB collection; the mobile app reads its own role's document at sign-in and re-renders its dashboard, navigation and feature gates from it. Nothing in the app is hard-coded to a role any more.

endpoints.mobile_read: GET /api/rbac/app-ui           -> resolves the CALLER's role and returns its config, merged over defaults
endpoints.admin_read_all: GET /api/rbac/app-ui/roles  -> every role's config, for the Admin Panel editor
endpoints.admin_write: PUT /api/rbac/app-ui/:roleKey -> upsert one role's config (admin/leader only)

_README.merge_rule: The server deep-merges the stored document over `defaults_by_role[role_key]`, and that over `global_defaults`. A missing key inherits; it never means 'hidden'. This makes a partially-filled Admin Panel form safe.
_README.fail_open_rule: If the app cannot fetch this config it falls back to its built-in defaults and shows the full menu. A config outage must never lock a field agent out of their own work. Real permission enforcement lives server-side in the API routes; this file controls PRESENTATION only.
_README.no_feature_deletion_rule: Setting a widget to hidden removes it from the DASHBOARD only. Every module remains reachable from the More tab unless `nav.hidden` explicitly lists it. This is a hard product rule: nothing is ever deleted, only re-prioritised.

role_key.description: Matches `role` on the staff_unified document, or a department key. This is the join key.

label.description: Human name shown in the Admin Panel role picker.

updated_by.description: user_id of the admin who last saved this role.

dashboard.description: Controls the home screen. `widgets` is ORDERED: index 0 renders directly under the hero. Anything not listed, or listed with visible:false, is still reachable from the More tab.

hero.description: The pinned top card. Operations rarely leave the office, so 'tasks_only' suits them; field sales need the geofenced clock ring.

widgets.description: Ordered dashboard widgets. Order in this array IS render order.

mandatory.description: When true the Admin Panel must not let this widget be hidden for this role. Encodes the product mandate that Sales always sees Tasks/Prospects/Leads/Notes and Operations always sees Tasks/Claims/Notes/Issues.

nav.description: Bottom tab bar and More menu. Tabs are capped at five by platform convention; extras spill into More automatically.

tabs.description: Ordered bottom-tab routes. First entry is the landing screen after sign-in.

more_sections.description: Ordered groups inside the More tab.

hidden.description: Routes removed from navigation entirely for this role. USE SPARINGLY: this is the only setting that makes a module unreachable. Deep links to a hidden route still resolve, because the API is the real authority.

features.description: Capability toggles. These gate CONTROLS, not data. The server re-checks every one of these on the API side; a client that ignores them gets a 403.

global_search_scopes.description: Which collections this role's global search may query.

theme.description: Optional per-role presentation. Omit to inherit the azure/teal system.

_ADMIN_PANEL_NOTES_FOR_WEB_DEV: Render one editor per role_key. Load every role from GET /api/rbac/app-ui/roles.
Widgets are a drag-to-reorder list. Array order is render order; do not add a separate `order` integer, it will drift out of sync with the array.
A widget with mandatory:true must render its visibility switch disabled and ON. That encodes the product rule; do not enforce it only in the mobile client.
The `hidden` array is the ONLY control that makes a module unreachable. Surface it behind a confirm, worded as 'remove from this role's navigation entirely'.
Everything else that is switched off simply moves to the More tab. Say so in the UI, or admins will assume they have deleted a feature.
Saving writes the WHOLE document for that role via PUT. The server deep-merges over defaults, so an omitted key inherits rather than disabling.
Show `updated_by` and `updated_at` on the editor. Two admins editing one role is the likeliest source of confusion.

PREVIEW ENGINE: dock a live phone mockup beside these controls. Full spec in ADMIN_PANEL_SYNC.md section 3. It must render the SANITISED config (unknown keys dropped, mandatory re-asserted, max_items clamped, duplicates removed) and not the raw form state, so that pressing Save never moves the preview.

PREVIEW ENGINE: an EMPTY widgets array means 'never configured' and the app substitutes its full built-in default dashboard. A preview that shows an empty phone for an empty array is the most misleading thing it could do.
PREVIEW ENGINE: never fetch or display real client/lead/claim/staff records in the mockup. Use fixed synthetic placeholders. It is a layout tool, not a data surface.

_KNOWN_GAP.status: FULLY RESOLVED. nav.tabs + nav.hidden as of mobile Phase 10 (2026-08-11); nav.more_sections as of mobile Phase 26 (2026-08-12). All three nav fields are now consumed on device. The only sub-field still not consumed is nav.more_sections[].collapsed_by_default (needs collapsible-group UI; ANDROID/docs/spec/PHASE-26.md D-5).
_KNOWN_GAP.detail: ANDROID/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx builds the bottom bar from useAppUi().tabs (resolveTabs() in ANDROID/src/store/appUi.tsx, ordered by nav.tabs, filtered by nav.hidden). ANDROID/src/app/(tabs)/more.tsx (Phase 26) renders its content-module groups from arrangeMoreSections(config.nav.more_sections, MORE_KEYS, isHidden) — so a role/department document's group titles, order and membership now drive the More tab. The admin oversight group and the personal rows (viewing-as/earnings) stay fixed by design (PHASE-26 D-2/D-3); nav.hidden still removes any module everywhere.
_KNOWN_GAP.consequence: Editing a department's app_role_preferences nav.more_sections now changes its More-tab grouping/titles/order on the next cold start, no APK. The Admin Panel's 'stored, not yet live on device' labelling (ADMIN_PANEL_SYNC.md §3.6.8) is now WRONG for nav.more_sections too and should be dropped for all three nav fields — heads-up filed to cgpe-admin via contracts/INBOX.md, 2026-08-12.
_KNOWN_GAP.fix_owner: none — closed. (Future: consume collapsed_by_default if collapsible More-groups are ever wanted; no backend or panel change needed for that either.)
